🚀 time-tracker-4-browser | TypeScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: Helping users understand, manage, and improve their browsing habits by tracking time spent on websites, setting limits, and blocking distracting sites.
✨ Key Features: • Track browsing time and visit counts • Detailed records and daily activity review • Dashboards, website analysis, and habit reports
📖 Summary: Time Tracker - Web Habit Builder is a browser extension designed to help users understand and manage their online habits. It provides detailed tracking of website usage, analytical reports, website blocking, and focus tools like Pomodoro sessions, with cross-browser compatibility and data synchronization/backup options.
